newsitem.title: USA: Market Facts '96 growth rates difficult to match.
newsitem.headline: Market Facts '96 growth rates difficult to match.

text.p: Market Facts Inc said Tuesday that the growth rates it achieved in 1996 will be difficult to repeat.
Earlier, it reported net income for the year rose 92 percent to a record $4.3 million, and earnings per share doubled to $1.14.
Revenue for the year rose 30 percent to a record $83.8 million.

"While it is not our practice to publicly forecast financial results, we have outpaced industry growth by a considerable margin and, in terms of profitability in the near term, we are optimistic that our earnings growth will match or exceed our revenue growth," Tom Payne, president, said in a statement.

Market Facts, a market research and information firm, said revenue increases for the year reflected the addition of major research programs for new clients and the expansion of existing client programs. The rise in net income was due to improved margins and lower state and local income taxes.
Payne added that Market Facts will continue its international expansion.
"In addition to our substantial operation in Canada, last year we purchased a minority interest in a Miami-based market research firm specializing in Latin America," he added.
He said Market Facts hopes to finalize an affiliation with two European firms this month, and intends to gain a foothold in Asia this year.
"None of these international activities will generate appreciable near-term profits, but they will allow us to better satisfy the needs of our growing customer base," Payne said.
He added that Market Facts will actively seek domestic acquisitions or partnerships to expand its customer base, product offerings or industries served.
